root_cause: A3 PRE stub failed to preserve the live RAX return from shipping 1.45 legacy_pre before invoking a3_capture_pre_ps. The caller immediately dereferences [RAX+0x48].
runtime_context: U/L producer preflight failed and U/L was nominally fail-open, but the static PRE wrapper remained active, so the ABI corruption still occurred.
fix: Preserve/restore RAX across a3_capture_pre_ps. Source also gates capture when U/L is disabled.
